programs.title: The First Class Travel Show
programs.desc: Presenter Josie Gibson embarks on a unique adventure during which she experiences the highest levels of comfort and elegance.Her journey is full of exclusive attractions and luxurious amenities.

programs.title: The Truth about Alcohol
programs.desc: British doctor Javid Abdelmoneim shows the impact of alcoholic beverages on our body and the risks associated with their consumption.To present the harmful effects of alcohol, he uses the latest research results.It explains, among other things, why some people get drunk faster.It also verifies the common opinion that drinking wine is good for your health, and whether a drink before going to bed actually makes you sleep better.We will also learn what effect alcohol has on our stomachs and the feeling of hunger.

programs.title: The Price of a Perfect Body with Olivia Attwood
programs.desc: Reality star, TV presenter and model Olivia Attwood reveals the behind-the-scenes of plastic surgery.It draws attention to the risks associated with the surgeries that people undergo in pursuit of the ideal.

programs.title: Embarrassing Bodies
programs.desc: Dr. Christian Jessen and his team of doctors help people suffering from rare and very embarrassing diseases.In this series, medics will face really difficult challenges.
